title: cendor-guardrails policy
description: A config-as-data guardrails policy for cendor.guardrails.load_policy(). Only the deterministic built-in rules are constructible from a file; rules needing a callable or a live client are wired in code.

version.description: Your policy version (any string). Recorded as policy_version on every decision, alongside the content hash (policy_hash), so the audit chain proves which policy was active.

guardrails.description: The ordered list of deterministic guardrails.

args.description: Keyword arguments splatted into the rule factory (e.g. {"words": ["..."]} for keyword_deny).

stage.description: One intervention point or a list of them.

name.description: Optional label recorded on every decision this guardrail emits.
